resources.string: Open the browser, enter this code, then approve access. Long-press the code to copy it.
Waiting for you to approve the code on GitHub
Set an OAuth client ID in Settings before connecting to GitHub.
Permission to display over other apps is needed for the floating window.
No browser is available to open the GitHub page.
GitForge shows a small window that stays visible while you enter the code in a browser. This needs permission to display over other apps. The window only shows the sign-in code and never your token.
